_format: skill-creator eval format — see https://agentskills.io/skill-creation/evaluating-skills. Run each prompt in a fresh session with and without the skill; grade the assertions.

evals.prompt: This session taught us a lot about our deploy pipeline. Before we close: distill this thread so we don't lose the learnings.
assertions: Identifies this as Phase 1 and reads prompt-1-distill.md
Executes the prompt file verbatim — does not paraphrase, trim, or reorder it
Produces a self-contained digest that an integrator who cannot see this thread could use
Does not skip ahead to writing repo docs (that is Phase 3's job)

evals.prompt: Harvest what we learned in my last four Claude Code sessions in this repo. They're all closed already.
assertions: Locates the session JSONL transcripts under ~/.claude/projects instead of trying to distill the current conversation
Dumps each transcript with scripts/dump_transcript.py so subagent hand-back reports and queued user messages are kept
Runs one subagent per thread (or per part of a split dump) whose brief contains prompt-1-distill.md verbatim after a short input preamble
Has each subagent write its digest to a file and return only a short summary
Consolidates the digests with prompt-2-consolidate.md (in batches with a final merge when there are many) without modifying the repo

evals.prompt: Here are five thread digests pasted below. Consolidate them into one knowledge set. [digest 1] ... [digest 5]
assertions: Identifies this as Phase 2 and reads prompt-2-consolidate.md
Operates ONLY on the pasted digests
Output is deduplicated and truth-checked across digests

evals.prompt: Take this consolidated knowledge set and fold it into the repo docs and skills. [knowledge set]
assertions: Identifies this as Phase 3 and reads prompt-3-synthesize.md
Inventories the repo's existing docs/skills/conventions FIRST
Presents the item-to-action PLAN table and waits for approval before writing anything
LOW-confidence items are verified against the repo or deferred — never enshrined as fact

evals.prompt: We just decided to move session storage from Redis to PostgreSQL. Write the ADR for it.
assertions: Treats this as recording one architecture decision (the adr-writer skill's territory), not as harvesting knowledge from threads
Does not start a distill, consolidate or synthesize phase
